{{Quote|The suspect is a Rodian named Kalio Uldi. And be on our guard because even though he may be a coward, he's likely to have friends that are not.|Captain Coraline Dynes to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Kalio Uldi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempCommonerRodianMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Kalio Uldi]]
Kalio Uldi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
